# Product Tools

Look up and search food products. Start here to get barcodes.

## getProductByBarcode

**Get product by barcode** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Get the full product record for a barcode: name, brand, nutrients per 100 g (and per serving), Nutri-Score, Green-Score, NOVA group, ingredients, allergens and additives. Data from Open Food Facts, merged with USDA/Nutritionix when configured.

::: tip MCP Apps
Hosts that support MCP Apps render this result as an interactive card.
:::

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |

### Output

- `product`: object

### Example

## searchProducts

**Search products** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Search food products by text, brand and/or category, optionally limited to a maximum Nutri-Score grade or NOVA group. Returns summaries with barcodes; use getProductByBarcode for details.

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `query` | string | No | Free text, e.g. "greek yogurt" |
| `brand` | string | No | Brand name, e.g. "Danone" |
| `category` | string | No | Category name or OFF tag, e.g. "breakfast cereals" or "en:breakfast-cereals" |
| `nutriScoreMax` | `A` \| `B` \| `C` \| `D` \| `E` | No | Worst acceptable Nutri-Score grade (e.g. "B" returns A and B) |
| `novaMax` | integer | No | Most processed acceptable NOVA group (1–4) |
| `page` | integer | No |  (1–100, default `1`) |
| `pageSize` | integer | No |  (1–50, default `20`) |

### Output

- `items`: object[]
- `pagination`: object
- `sources`: string[]

### Example

```json
// searchProducts({"query":"nutella","pageSize":3})
{
  "items": [
    {
      "barcode": "0009800800049",
      "name": "Nutella & go! hazelnut spread + breadsticks",
      "brand": "Nutella",
      "categories": [
        "snacks"
      ],
      "nutriScoreGrade": "E",
      "novaGroup": 3,
      "thumbnail": "https://images.openfoodfacts.org/images/products/000/980/080/0049/front_en.5.200.jpg",
      "sources": [
        "openfoodfacts"
      ]
    },
    {
      "barcode": "0098008952506",
      "name": "Nutella",
      "brand": "Nutella",
      "categories": [],
      "thumbnail": "https://images.openfoodfacts.org/images/products/009/800/895/2506/front_en.3.200.jpg",
      "sources": [
        "openfoodfacts"
      ]
    },
    "… 1 more"
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 3,
    "totalItems": 631,
    "totalPages": 211,
    "hasNext": true,
    "hasPrev": false
  },
  "sources": [
    "openfoodfacts"
  ]
}
```
